# Abdul Rehman Akbar

> Abdul Rehman Akbar is a PhD candidate in Biomedical Engineering at The Ohio State University (AI4Path Lab) building deep learning models that predict cancer recurrence, molecular subtypes, and gene mutations from H&E whole-slide images.

- Position: PhD Candidate, Biomedical Engineering, The Ohio State University; Graduate Research Associate, AI4Path Lab, Department of Pathology, OSU Wexner Medical Center
- Advisor: Dr. Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi
- Research: computational pathology; deep learning on H&E whole-slide images for cancer recurrence, molecular subtyping, and gene mutation prediction; LLMs for pathology reports
- Named methods: PathRosetta (lung adenocarcinoma recurrence), GenoGlyph (pan-cancer mutation inference), PanSubNet (pancreatic cancer subtyping), PathoScribe (LLM pathology report retrieval)
